description: This file contains functions and procedures for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a network connection via a modem using shell scripting. It includes initialization, configuration, modem info retrieval, and network interface management.

methods.name: proto_ncm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the NCM protocol, setting default values and adding configuration options.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the network interface by configuring the modem, retrieving manufacturer info, initializing, and creating DHCP and DHCPv6 configurations.

methods.name: proto_ncm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the network interface, disconnects the modem, and cleans up resources.
